d: Watch the Superhit Peppy Romantic Song 'Dekha Na Haye Re Socha Na' from the blockbuster classic adventure comedy Hindi movie 'Bombay To Goa' directed by S. Ramanathan. The movie stars Amitabh Bachchan, Aruna Irani, Mehmood & Shatrughan Sinha. Music composed by R. D. Burman. This song is sung by Kishore Kumar.
